newsitems.title: WORK ORDER #001: OFFICIAL GAMEPLAY WALKTHROUGH
newsitems.author: casssiechen
newsitems.contents: Clock in. Your first Work Order starts here. Our first official gameplay walkthrough takes you through one complete Exterminauts work order, from deployment to extraction — and a closer look at everything standing between your crew and a finished job. On Planet Tian, completing the contract means more than checking objectives off a list. Meet some of the Pests you’ll encounter in the field and see how different threats can quickly change the fight. Get a closer look at the weapons and equipment at your disposal, how they can be put to work against the local wildlife, and what happens when a routine shift starts getting out of hand. Along the way, the walkthrough also breaks down the objectives, combat encounters, equipment, and other gameplay details that make up a full work order — all the way to extraction. The job is dangerous. The wildlife is worse. ➡️ Wishlist Exterminauts on Steam.

newsitems.title: NOW HIRING: EXTERMINAUTS
newsitems.author: Soma
newsitems.contents: Forward into the next shift—and a brand-new line of work.Exterminauts is a three-player co-op third-person shooter where blue-collar crews take the contracts no one else will touch. Head into the hottest zones on Planet Tian, keep the worksite running, and fight through a living alien ecosystem until your extraction.PUNCH IN for the toughest jobs. Choose your work order, take on hazardous objectives, and adapt when the contract stops looking routine.CLEAN UP with industrial firepower. Keep the site operational and turn heavy-duty tools into Pest-control weapons. GET PAID — if the crew gets out.  Stay on the job, finish the contract, and get extracted together.Built for the hottest zones. The last crew to leave the worksite. Ready to keep the lights on for one more day.The contract calls it routine maintenance. Planet Tian has other ideas.This is the job.Punch in. Clean up. Get paid.➡ Wishlist Exterminauts on Steam.
